queries.sql:
SELECT EXISTS(
                  SELECT 1 FROM catalog_fema_flood
                  WHERE sfha_tf = 'T' AND ST_Contains(geometry, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-122.2509, 37.8444), 4326)))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM catalog_transit_stops WHERE ST_Intersects(geometry, ST_Transform(ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-122.2509, 37.8444), 4326), 3857), 1609), 4326))

SELECT to_jsonb(t) - 'geometry' AS props
                FROM catalog_census_demographics t
                WHERE ST_Contains(t.geometry, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-122.2509, 37.8444), 4326)) LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM catalog_epa_facilities WHERE ST_Intersects(geometry, ST_Transform(ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-122.2509, 37.8444), 4326), 3857), 1609), 4326))

SELECT EXISTS(
                  SELECT 1 FROM catalog_calfire_fhsz
                  WHERE ST_Contains(geometry, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-122.2509, 37.8444), 4326)))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM catalog_overture_pois WHERE ST_Intersects(geometry, ST_Transform(ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-122.2509, 37.8444), 4326), 3857), 1609), 4326))

SELECT to_jsonb(t) - 'geometry' AS props,
                           ST_Distance(ST_Transform(t.geometry, 3857),
                                       ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-122.2509, 37.8444), 4326), 3857)) AS dist_m,
                           ST_X(t.geometry) AS lng, ST_Y(t.geometry) AS lat
                    FROM catalog_nces_schools t
                    WHERE ST_Intersects(t.geometry, ST_Transform(ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-122.2509, 37.8444), 4326), 3857), 1609), 4326))
                    ORDER BY t.geometry <-> ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-122.2509, 37.8444), 4326)
                    LIMIT 3

                  WHERE sfha_tf = 'T' AND ST_Contains(geometry, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-122.2545, 37.724), 4326)))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM catalog_transit_stops WHERE ST_Intersects(geometry, ST_Transform(ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-122.2545, 37.724), 4326), 3857), 1609), 4326))

SELECT to_jsonb(t) - 'geometry' AS props
                FROM catalog_census_demographics t
                WHERE ST_Contains(t.geometry, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-122.2545, 37.724), 4326)) LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM catalog_epa_facilities WHERE ST_Intersects(geometry, ST_Transform(ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-122.2545, 37.724), 4326), 3857), 1609), 4326))

SELECT EXISTS(
                  SELECT 1 FROM catalog_calfire_fhsz
                  WHERE ST_Contains(geometry, ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-122.2545, 37.724), 4326)))
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM catalog_overture_pois WHERE ST_Intersects(geometry, ST_Transform(ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-122.2545, 37.724), 4326), 3857), 1609), 4326))

SELECT to_jsonb(t) - 'geometry' AS props,
                           ST_Distance(ST_Transform(t.geometry, 3857),
                                       ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-122.2545, 37.724), 4326), 3857)) AS dist_m,
                           ST_X(t.geometry) AS lng, ST_Y(t.geometry) AS lat
                    FROM catalog_nces_schools t
                    WHERE ST_Intersects(t.geometry, ST_Transform(ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-122.2545, 37.724), 4326), 3857), 1609), 4326))
                    ORDER BY t.geometry <-> ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-122.2545, 37.724), 4326)
                    LIMIT 3
